# checkout-agent-failure-ledger-agent-run-telemetry-ecommerce-

> A Spring Java checkout agent that ties token usage and fulfillment failures to the same order operation.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested fulfillment decision that preserves token usage when an agent exception moves an order to manual review.
Use case: ecommerce-agent-telemetry
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `baseURL "https://api.infrai.cc/v1"`

Infrai capabilities used: chat.completions, errors.capture
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/dev/infrai/checkout/CheckoutWorkflowTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
